message: さっちんのラブラブ大作戦２

name: Nanaka
message: 「What is it」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa, someone's in a bad moood」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-Not really」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I got it. It's because I baked a cake today, isn't iiit? Hit the mark?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh... It's nothing like that」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sure, I'll let you say thaaat」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Still, even for a 39-point cake, Synn's reaction wasn't bad, riiight?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well... I guess so」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I get how you feel, buuut things can't stay like this foreveeer」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If you bake cookies or cakes, guys will fall head over heels for yooou」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Head over heels... huh」

name: Sacchin
message: 「For starters, you gotta just try making someee」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, no way」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Woah. Ruling it out already?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, he'd just... say 'it's good' and nothing else anyway」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Geez, you're hopeless. Guess we have no choice but to go with a direct attack then」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's not like I didn't do anything. I tried to get us alone together!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Just getting alone together isn't enouuugh. You have to be way more aggressiveee」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaddaya mean?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Once you're alone together, you cling onto him nice and tight. And then casually, ummm...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Try pressing your boobs against him!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Boobs!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-Wh-Wh-What, how could I possibly do that?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Once you say you're gonna do it, you just gotta do it! If you wanna steal the lead from Ria-senpai, you have to get up close and personal and make a direct move!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-But, against Ria-senpai... something like that won't...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Then push things all the way! Make it a done deal--have a dangerous Shoji Jo!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You mean 'affair'!! Y-You... do you even know what that means when you say it?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even if I don't, as long as Nana-chan gets it, there's no problem! Anyway, you gotta go at least that far!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I see...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'll do my best」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's the spirit!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks for everything」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're welcome! And be sure to tell me how it goes!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Hey, are you maybe just getting a kick out of this?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe. No way!」
